items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses and unto Aaron, Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh.
items.claim: In verse 9:8, the text says the LORD told Moses and Aaron to take handfuls of ashes from the furnace. It also says Moses was to sprinkle them toward the heaven while Pharaoh watched.
items.action: instructed Moses and Aaron to take handfuls of furnace ashes, and Moses to sprinkle them toward heaven
items.object: Moses and Aaron; handfuls of ashes of the furnace
items.mechanism: Moses sprinkles the ashes toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh
